requirement: App Statistic JA QS Download tab counts admitted quickstart zip requests with their links and recorded referring page, without inventing links or multiplying user counts

oracle.invariant: view=quickstarts drops version, channel, platform and account filters and keeps template; template is dropped on the desktop views. A quickstart row carries requestedAt, template and cms split from the release tag and the account's first-sign-in source; a deleted account's row stays counted with userId and email null. The rolling date range includes a request exactly at the boundary and excludes one a millisecond earlier. Users count quickstarts beside downloads and installs without multiplying them (3 downloads, 2 installs, 2 quickstarts) and a quickstart-only account appears. Quickstart paging is server-side: 120 rows give 50, 50, 20 with stable distinct ids. Quickstart detail lists the same account's quickstart requests and activity; a request whose account was deleted lists only itself. A Joomla quickstart row links https://www.joomlart.com/joomla/templates/<template>; a non-Joomla cms gets no template link; every row links its release on JoomlArt-Products/ja-products. A referrer is kept only as an absolute http(s) URL of at most 512 characters without credentials or fragment; javascript:, data:, relative, garbage and overlong values become null. An explicit ref wins over the Referer header; an origin-only Referer is kept; Tracy's own origin is never a referrer. The JoomlArt sign-in carries ref on a template landing next through the callback, and next still never leaves Tracy's origin. The landing's Download link carries ref; the download door stores it, stores null for a bad one and still serves the zip; rows written before recording show a null referrer. A referrer keeps only scheme, host and path; Tracy's own host on any scheme or port is not a referrer; the Google/GitHub sign-in callback answers Referrer-Policy: no-referrer so the provider is never recorded.
